description.content:
Milestone escrow on PayPal. A client funds a contract (PayPal Orders, intent AUTHORIZE),
each milestone is released only when a machine-checkable test passes (partial capture +
PayPal Payouts), and anything not earned is returned by voiding the authorization.
The AI (Gemini) drafts contracts and explains results; it never decides whether money moves.
